q: Menurut Peraturan 8(1) Loji CF 2024, pemilik loji CF perlu memastikan loji diselenggara:
e: Reg. 8(1): the plant requiring certificate of fitness is maintained at all times.

q: Peraturan 8(3) Loji CF 2024 mewajibkan pemilik membuat perjanjian dengan Orang Kompeten bagi:
e: Reg. 8(3): enter into an agreement with a competent person for servicing, adjustment and comprehensive examination.

q: Salah satu keperluan penyelenggaraan ialah:
c: Meningkatkan kebersihan tempat kerja demi keselamatan
e: Necessity: smooth-running of plant operations, safety of plant operations, workplace cleanliness for safety purposes.

q: Penyelenggaraan pencegahan melibatkan:
c: Penggantian peralatan rosak mengikut jadual dan penyimpanan rekod
e: Preventive maintenance: regularly according to set schedules; replace/restore faulty equipment per schedule; keep maintenance and repair records.

q: Penyelenggaraan pencegahan bertujuan mengelakkan kegagalan peralatan yang boleh menyebabkan:
e: Preventive maintenance conducted to prevent faulty equipment/failures that may result in work disruption and accidents.

q: Dandang stim termasuk ekonomiser dan pemanas lampau (super heater) yang:
w: Diletakkan di bangunan lain tanpa sambungan
e: Steam boiler: closed vessel generating steam above atmospheric pressure, includes economiser, super heater and connected pipes and fittings.

q: Jentera angkat (lifting machinery) ditakrifkan sebagai:
c: Sebarang peralatan untuk mengangkat, menaikkan, mengangkut atau menurunkan beban
e: Lifting machinery: any equipment for lifting, raising, transporting or lowering loads.

q: Yang manakah TIDAK tersenarai sebagai jentera angkat dalam Jadual Ketujuh?
e: Seventh Schedule list: lift, escalator, walkalator, hoist, tower crane, overhead travelling crane (>4,000 kg), quay crane, suspended access equipment, launching gantry.

q: Melantik firma berdaftar ialah contoh kaedah penyelenggaraan:
e: Statutory preventive maintenance: as per regulatory requirements – keeping maintenance records and appointing registered firms.

q: Penyelenggaraan kerosakan (breakdown) dipilih kerana:
c: Memberi pilihan untuk membaiki atau melupuskan jentera
e: Breakdown maintenance – why: company policy, reduces cost, machinery not regularly stopped, option of repairing or disposing.

q: Penyelenggaraan dalam talian (online) diperlukan apabila proses seperti berikut memerlukan mesin beroperasi:
e: Online maintenance – why: not practical to stop machine; cleaning, repair, coordination, troubleshooting require machine in operation.

q: Arahan atau cadangan pengilang mempengaruhi:
e: Frequency dependent on: age, damage records, operating conditions, manufacturer recommendation, statutory requirements, company policy.

q: Seksyen 15(2)(a) OSHA berkaitan penyelenggaraan menghendaki majikan menyediakan dan menyelenggara:
c: Loji dan sistem kerja yang selamat dan tanpa risiko kesihatan
e: Section 15(2)(a): provision and maintenance of plant and systems of work that are, so far as is practicable, safe and without risks to health.

q: Pemeriksaan berjadual (harian, mingguan, bulanan) untuk mengesan retak, bolt longgar atau pengadang rosak termasuk dalam aktiviti:
e: Maintenance activities: 1 cleaning & housekeeping; 2 inspection & monitoring (scheduled, check cracks, loose bolts, damaged guards); 3 lubrication & servicing.

q: Menguji butang henti kecemasan, penggera dan saling kunci termasuk dalam aktiviti:
e: Activity 5 – Testing & Verification: test emergency stop buttons, alarms, interlocks, and machine guards.

q: Mengangkat bahagian berat dan postur janggal semasa penyelenggaraan ialah bahaya:
e: Hazards: mechanical (entanglement), electrical (live wires), ergonomic (lifting heavy parts, awkward postures), chemical (lubricants, solvents).

q: Tumpahan minyak dan alatan yang ditinggalkan di laluan pejalan kaki boleh menyebabkan:
e: Hazards: slips, trips & falls – oil spills, tools left in walkway.

q: Jika aktiviti pelinciran dan servis diabaikan, akibatnya boleh menjadi:
c: Galas terlalu panas yang membawa kepada kebakaran atau letupan
e: Neglected lubrication & servicing: overheated bearings → fire/explosion; machine seizure → struck by ejected parts.

q: Jika pengujian butang henti kecemasan diabaikan, kemungkinan akibatnya ialah:
c: Mesin tidak dapat dihentikan semasa kecemasan
e: Testing & verification neglected: emergency stop not working → unable to stop machine; alarm failure → no warning.

q: Langkah kawalan aktiviti penyelenggaraan termasuk:
c: Pemilihan pekerja yang betul dan penggunaan papan tanda keselamatan
e: Control measures: training, safe work procedures, safe system of work, supervision, rules; permit to work, proper worker selection, safety signage, PPE, suitable tools.
